soft_regions.name: tire_patch

selection.selector: From front_left wheel seed only: native x in [-0.202,-0.170], y in [0.278,0.322], z in [-0.204,-0.185]. Select contiguous exposed lower outboard rubber arc with radial distance from (y,z)=(0.30,-0.142) above 0.050; exclude metallic rim. Patch is assigned BEFORE wheel body, with a single dedicated deforming render root; retain every selected source face unchanged at rest.
selection.reason: Rounded dark tire ring supports rubber-like local compliance; small outboard lower arc permits bounded visible loading.

young_modulus.reason: Coarse compliant rubber patch prior, not inflated whole-tire material measurement.

load_force.reason: Bounded local contact probe load target.

probe_travel.reason: Finite local indentation command; measure actual contact and deformation.

grid_spacing.reason: Coarse covering tetrahedral flex volume; refine only enough for actual skin binding.

soft_regions.reason: Create a small covering 3D tetrahedral flex volume enclosing ALL native patch vertices. Pin inner and border nodes to rotating wheel owner, not world. Bind visible vertices with nonnegative barycentric weights reconstructing rest geometry, and use actual flex states for rendering. Spin first with unloaded patch; stop at neutral modulo full turns and contact-load the exposed lower/outboard patch with a mocap probe, unload and measure recovery. Coarse local elasticity is an active attempt, never tire inflation or full rubber validation.

native_scale.reason: Uniform metric scale prior informed by elongated native bounds and source proportions.

native_offset.reason: Estimated vertical placement from native lower bound times scale; native X/Y unchanged.

friction.reason: Simple dry contact prior; material friction unmeasured.

interactions.name: front_left_wheel_turn
interactions.action: Hold other mechanisms neutral, advance unwrapped position from 0 to 2*pi then beyond 2*pi by 0.2 rad; stop with bounded torque. No joint range or actuator position bounds.
interactions.expected: Native rim and tire follow actual wheel pose; rear coaxial tire multiplicity preserved. Active patch follows owner plus actual flex displacement.

interactions.name: steering_and_spin
interactions.action: Exercise steering at -pi/6, 0, +pi/6 while front wheel spins unwrapped through a full turn.
interactions.expected: Wheel spin axis rotates with its steering carrier; no independent world-axis spin or detached visible wheel.

interactions.name: open_and_close
interactions.action: Open individually to pi/4 then pi/2, hold and return to zero; include combined open state with released latch prior.
interactions.expected: Native moving surfaces follow their hinges. Check physical endpoints within frozen tolerance, do not reduce ranges for small seams.

interactions.name: visible_continuity
interactions.action: Before the one host dynamics attempt inspect rest-frame hierarchy at 0, midpoint and full finite travel; for spin inspect 0, pi/2, pi, 3*pi/2 without stops. Record each owner attachment and local root transform.
interactions.expected: No disconnected mirror, wheel support or panel ownership. Kinematic continuity is a construction check, not simulated success.

interactions.name: load_tire
interactions.action: One host contact-load/unload phase sequence with wheel held after full-turn demonstration; measure probe contact, patch displacement relative to wheel and recovery.
interactions.expected: Dedicated native patch visibly deforms nonrigidly; report measured maxima and recovery residual, including failed or unstable attempts honestly.

review_requirements: Before the host attempt, account for every native face exactly once across rigid roots and tire_patch; verify unchanged rest triangles/UV/PBR and matching SI rest transforms. Inspect colored selections for complete wheels including any paired rear surfaces, door/window/mirror ownership, cargo wall versus floor ownership and retained thin members. Record nonempty moving surfaces and patch; honor the two connector area caps with no native removals/edits.

Inspect visible attachment at 0, pi/4 and pi/2 for both doors and all three cargo panels, and at -pi/6, 0, +pi/6 for both steering carriers. Measure attachment-point separation and identify each moving/fixed owner; inspect mirrors and wheel supports for detached fragments. Keep approved axes/ranges and record exposed gaps. Only the two already approved steering connector additions are authorized; do not demand detailed interiors or a dense collision sweep.

Compile all four spin hinges limited=false without range or actuator angular bounds. Within the single host trajectory test unwrapped spin beyond 2*pi, with visible rim/tire landmarks at representative quarter-turn poses. Exercise BOTH spin_front_left and spin_front_right under their respective steer_left/right carriers and check that spin axes follow carrier orientation; spin_rear_left does not substitute for the right front test. Record joint travel and visible motion separately; never convert spin to oscillation.

Construct a nonempty tetrahedral tire_patch with free deforming nodes, owner-relative border/inner pins and nonnegative skin weights reconstructing native rest vertices within 0.001 metric native diagonal. Verify patch follows front_left_wheel during unloaded spin without doubled transforms. After returning to neutral modulo full turns, use the one host attempt to record actual probe contact, loaded nonrigid displacement relative to owner, unload and recovery residual; show the corresponding native visible patch deformation. Rigid following alone fails this test.

Use only the single host dynamics attempt for core opening/closing, steering, spin and local load phases. Report measured endpoints, finite-state stability, visible binding and contacts using frozen physics_tolerances; baseline small penetrations need no invented locality proof. Keep continuous angles unbounded and preserve all usable controls, native PBR and active soft attempt even if measurements fail. Distinguish simulated successes, parameter-only preview actions and missing/failed actions; tolerant contact is not strict collision-free validation.

approximation_gaps.reason: Native roof and cargo floor show missing/striped surfaces in top view; preserve them. Cab/door inner faces and hidden hinge interiors are incomplete and not reconstructed; two small steering connectors are the only approved additions.

Simple boxes and cylinders omit detailed hinge seams, tire tread and cavity contact. Use compound cab/floor/frame proxies and measured frozen contact helper, tolerating baseline small contacts without invented locality. No strict collision-free claim; broad/deep overlap remains a reported failure.
